delivery.outcome: Make single and nested multi-module native consumer distribution contracts executable in integration tests, update canonical evidence, and independently review/publish/merge.
nonGoals: Change backend/runtime implementation, C ABI, dependency versions or supported platforms.
Publish to registries, deploy, migrate consumers or edit protected delivery policy.
Claim the isolated wheelhouse canary is an enrolled protected CI gate.

architecture.decision: Parameterize existing real foreign-consumer sdist-to-wheel integration test for one and two compiled modules including a nested package; check selective source exclusion, all artifact/header hashes, actual installed extensions and foreign Rust ABI calls. Keep isolated offline wheelhouse proof as a separate controlled local canary.
architecture.rollback: Revert test/documentation change through independent protected review; retain raw canary/test receipts.

validation.evidence: Both single and nested two-module foreign sdists produce installable wheels, selected modules are native without source copies, unselected source remains; all manifest/header hashes match and foreign Rust ABI executes.
Full existing source, build, runtime, C/Rust/Python consumer and negative regressions remain green.
Existing indexed canonical standard has exact-source metadata; local gates, required remote checks, independent approval/merge and released owned-worktree cleanup verified.
